hint.text:
The part of the sentence that describes who is speaking and how they are speaking can be at the beginning or end of the speech.

Example:
“Can you put the kettle on?” asked Suzy.
Suzy asked, “Can you put the kettle on?”
hint.sound: The part of the sentence that describes who is speaking and how they are speaking can be at the beginning or end of the speech. For example, “Can you put the kettle on?” asked Suzy. Or. Suzy asked, “Can you put the kettle on?”

instruction.text: Rearrange the sentence so that the part that describes who is speaking is at the beginning.

atoms.a: “Can I see your ticket, please?” asked the conductor.
“I’m really cross with you!” yelled his mum.
“I really enjoyed the meal,” said Maisie.
“How are you feeling today?” asked the doctor.

instruction.text: Rearrange the sentence so that the part that describes who is speaking is at the end.

atoms.a: Ryan asked, “Can I go to the park with James?”
My dad shouted, “Stop winding up your brother!”
Ollie said, “My favourite films are comedy.”
The shop assistant asked, “Would you like a bag?”
